name: flow_esc_menu_online
description: In a party's match on a server Esc opens the same menu, without Restart, and the match plays on behind it (lockstep cannot wait for one player). Leave to hub asks first ("Leave the match?"), and once answered says LEAVE_MATCH to the server, whose caretaker takes the seat, and brings me back to the hub in the party.

steps.wait_until: Session.state_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and Game.sim != null and Game.sim.tick > 30

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Resume', 'Leave to hub'] and node('MenuTitle').text == 'Menu' and node('MenuLine').text == 'The match plays on'
steps.msg: online: Resume and Leave to hub; no Restart
the match plays on behind the plate

steps.assert: scene_path() == 'res://scenes/main.tscn' and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Leave the match', 'Stay'] and node('MenuTitle').text == 'Leave the match?' and node('MenuLine').text == 'The caretaker plays your seat to the end'
steps.msg: Leave to hub asks first, and says the caretaker plays the seat
nothing went to the server yet
Stay stands where Leave to hub stood, so a second click there says no
the server heard LEAVE_MATCH: the caretaker takes my seat

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').visible and Session.party_code() == 'K7Q4M' and Session.client != null
steps.msg: back in the hub, in the party, on the same connection
